**Unsigned software runs by default**
- No more "Unsigned Application" dialog or "Signature Check" errors: the emulator accepts programs without a Tapwave signature, so PopAccess and developer mode aren't needed. Tested with the unsigned Duke Nukem Mobile (reaches its main menu). Copy the .prc to PALM/Launcher and its data folder to PALM/Programs as before.
- Signed software (Stuntcar and the built-in apps) is unaffected.

Includes the 400 MHz option (v0.8), recompiler (v0.5), Remount SD card (v0.6) and the race-picture fix (v0.7).
